Protocol Buffers is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2017 to 2025.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [astudo](@/work/astudo.md); [bcnode-old](@/work/bcnode-old.md): Mining node with built-in block rover and DHT; [the-scratch](@/work/the-scratch.md): Single Page Application written in Elm with Elixir/Phoenix Backend.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Protocol Buffers: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Protocol Buffers to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
